name: Voice of the East
tagline: Cultural Media Hub & Offline-First Audio Streaming Ecosystem
description:
Voice of the East is a mobile-first cultural platform built to preserve and broadcast Igbo heritage, oral history, journalism, and community stories across unreliable networks and diverse devices.

The architecture addresses four core challenges:

Offline-first performance: TanStack React Query v5 + AsyncStorage provide cached content and resilient synchronization during poor connectivity.

Native audio: expo-audio enables background playback, lock-screen controls, interruption handling, and resilient streaming.

Igbo cultural calendar: A deterministic client-side engine calculates Eke, Orie, Afọ, and Nkwọ market days completely offline.

Responsive design: NativeWind v4 and adaptive breakpoints optimize long-form content across phones and tablets, with a 740px reading width on large displays.

Additional integrations such as expo-haptics and Sentry provide tactile interactions and production crash monitoring.

Outcome: a resilient, native cultural platform designed for reliable access, immersive storytelling, and long-term digital preservation of Igbo heritage.
metrics: 40% increase in average session duration via TTS accessibility features
Initial app load times reduced from 3.2s to under 1.1s under high latency
100% offline reliability for core historical texts and Igbo calendar utilities
Native 60FPS fluid gesture handling with zero thread jank
highlights: Advanced Text-to-Speech narration engine with sentence-splitting regex and speed controls
Lock Screen audio player support using a background playback stream trick
Traditional Igbo Market Day Calculator dynamically computing Eke, Orie, Afor, and Nkwo cycles
TanStack Query and Zustand AsyncStorage offline-first caching system
